name: Niçoise-Style Tuna Salad Sandwich with Eggs, Olives & Dressed Greens
ingredients: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water
instructions: Wash and dry lettuce, then separate the leaves; set aside one leaf per sandwich and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Add broccoli slaw to the bowl with the lettuce, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Drain tuna, place in a medium bowl, and flake with a fork.
Roughly chop eggs and add to the bowl with the tuna.
Mince olives and capers; add to the bowl.
Add pesto and mayo to the bowl, then stir to combine the sandwich filling.
To assemble sandwiches, layer reserved lettuce leaves and filling on the bottom half of each roll; close with the top half.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Drizzle salad with vinaigrette and enjoy!
author: Mealime
